title: Insights into the aggregation mechanism of RNA recognition motif domains in TDP-43: a theoretical exploration.
authors: Liu, Wei; Li, Chaoqun; Shan, Jiankai; Wang, Yan; Chen, Guangju
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TDP-43蛋白RRM结构域的聚集机制，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白相互作用和分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合体系无关。
abstract: The transactive response DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is associated with several diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) due to pathogenic aggregations. In this work, we examined the dimer, tetramer and hexamer models built from the RRM domains of TDP-43 using molecular dynamics simulations in combination with the protein-protein docking. Our results showed that the formations of the dimer models are mainly achieved by the interactions of the RRM1 domains. The parallel beta-sheet layers between the RRM1 domains provide most of the binding sites in these oligomer models, and thus play an important role in the aggregation process. The approaching of the parallel beta-sheet layers from small oligomer models gradually expand to large ones through the allosteric communication between the alpha1/alpha2 helices of the RRM1 domains, which maintains the binding affinities and interactions in the larger oligomer models. Using the repeatable-superimposing method based on the tetramer models, we proposed a new aggregation mechanism of RRM domains in TDP-43, which could well characterize the formation of the large aggregation models with the repeated, helical and rope-like structures. These new insights help to understand the amyloid-like aggregation phenomena of TDP-43 protein in ALS and FTLD diseases.
abstract_zh: 反式激活反应DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）与多种疾病相关，如肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶变性（FTLD），这些疾病源于致病性聚集。在本研究中，我们利用分子动力学模拟结合蛋白质-蛋白质对接，检查了基于TDP-43的RRM结构域构建的二聚体、四聚体和六聚体模型。结果表明，二聚体模型的形成主要由RRM1结构域之间的相互作用实现。RRM1结构域之间的平行β-折叠层在这些寡聚体模型中提供了大部分结合位点，因此在聚集过程中发挥重要作用。来自小寡聚体模型的平行β-折叠层通过RRM1结构域α1/α2螺旋之间的变构通讯逐渐扩展至大型模型，这维持了较大寡聚体模型中的结合亲和力和相互作用。基于四聚体模型的可重复叠加方法，我们提出了TDP-43中RRM结构域的一种新聚集机制，该机制能够很好地表征具有重复、螺旋和绳状结构的大型聚集模型的形成。这些新见解有助于理解ALS和FTLD疾病中TDP-43蛋白的淀粉样样聚集现象。
